title: 美瞳线：黑色与棕色怎么选
intro: 选择颜色之前，先看眼部轮廓、日常妆感和希望呈现的存在感。不是颜色越深就越适合。
intro_en: Consider the eye area, everyday makeup and desired definition before choosing a colour. Darker is not automatically more suitable.

sections.title: 黑色：存在感更明显
sections.description: 黑色通常让睫毛根部的轮廓更明显。是否需要这种对比，要放回整张脸和日常妆容中判断。
sections.description_en: Black generally gives the lash line more visual definition. Decide whether that contrast suits the whole face and the makeup normally worn.

sections.title: 棕色：轮廓更柔和
sections.description: 棕色偏柔和，适合希望眼部变化不太明显的沟通方向。具体色彩与线条范围先确认，不按固定模板处理。
sections.description_en: Brown offers a softer direction when the preference is for a subtler change. Confirm the colour and placement individually rather than following a fixed template.

sections.title: 适用情况与护理
sections.description: 结合眼部状态评估是否适合，恢复过程和护理要求会在操作前说明。具体感受与恢复情况因人而异。所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Suitability is assessed individually. Healing and aftercare are discussed before treatment, as comfort and recovery vary from person to person. All services include free touch-ups within one year.
